from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenueInfo(BaseModel):
    """Revenue change data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    current_period_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Current period revenue amount in yuan")
    prior_period_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Previous period revenue amount in yuan")
    revenue_growth_rate: float | None = Field(description="Revenue growth rate as a percentage")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the revenue figures from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_info: list[CompanyRevenueInfo]
